origin, 2010 and projected 2050. Note: The term non-Hispanic 
white alone is used to refer to people who reported being white 
and no other race and who are not Hispanic. The term black 
alone is used to refer to people who reported being black or 
African American and no other race, and the term Asian alone 
is used to refer to people who reported only Asian as their race.
